statement: The pinned hid-wiimote module decoders report native integer values even when they exceed advertised ABS bounds: accelerometers subtract512, Nunchuk sticks subtract128, Classic right axes and triggers expand five bits by2, and MotionPlus applies its fast/slow scale. The input core defuzzes rather than clipping these values. All-ones no-point IR bytes decode to1023/1023. A parity realization must preserve these consumer values rather than silently clamp or conflate missing points with visible edge coordinates.

applicability.scope: Consumer conversion, not physical calibration: hid-wiimote-modules.c accel/IR/Nunchuk/Classic/MP decoder functions; input.c145-192; Dolphin Camera no-points byte model. Advertised ranges and native raw domains remain separate.
